# Extend prior aggregation to include supervisor and supervisee counts per DLC via space_supervisor_usage.

# Orgs per DLC
orgs_sql = '''
WITH orgs AS (
  SELECT m.dlc_key, COUNT(DISTINCT m.fclt_organization_key) AS total_facility_organizations
  FROM org_map m
  GROUP BY m.dlc_key
)
SELECT * FROM orgs
'''
orgs_df = db_api.execute_query(user_id, chat_id, orgs_sql)

# Buildings/floors and square footage per DLC
bldg_sql = '''
WITH dlc_bldg AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT m.dlc_key, r.fclt_building_key
  FROM rooms r
  JOIN org_map m ON r.fclt_organization_key = m.fclt_organization_key
  WHERE r.fclt_building_key IS NOT NULL
),
agg_b AS (
  SELECT d.dlc_key,
         SUM(DISTINCT b.building_height) AS total_building_heights,
         SUM(DISTINCT b.ext_gross_area) AS total_square_footage
  FROM dlc_bldg d
  JOIN buildings b ON b.fclt_building_key = d.fclt_building_key
  GROUP BY d.dlc_key
),
agg_floors AS (
  SELECT d.dlc_key, COUNT(DISTINCT f.floor) AS total_number_of_floors
  FROM dlc_bldg d
  JOIN floors f ON f.fclt_building_key = d.fclt_building_key
  GROUP BY d.dlc_key
)
SELECT COALESCE(b.dlc_key, f.dlc_key) AS dlc_key,
       b.total_building_heights,
       b.total_square_footage,
       f.total_number_of_floors
FROM agg_b b
FULL OUTER JOIN agg_floors f ON f.dlc_key = b.dlc_key
'''
bldg_df = db_api.execute_query(user_id, chat_id, bldg_sql)

# DLC directory for names
name_sql = '''
SELECT dlc_key, MAX(dlc_name) AS dlc_name
FROM dlc_directory
GROUP BY dlc_key
'''
name_df = db_api.execute_query(user_id, chat_id, name_sql)

# Supervisors and supervisees per DLC from space_supervisor_usage.
# Map each row to DLC via dept_names when it equals a DLC key pattern; otherwise try joining on org_map via HR/org data is not in T, so we use dept_names as DLC_KEY proxy if it matches /^D_.+/.
sup_sql = '''
WITH raw AS (
  SELECT dept_names AS dlc_key_candidate,
         SUM(num_of_supervisees) AS total_supervisees,
         COUNT(DISTINCT mit_id) AS total_supervisors
  FROM beaver.space_supervisor_usage
  GROUP BY dept_names
),
filtered AS (
  SELECT dlc_key_candidate AS dlc_key,
         total_supervisees,
         total_supervisors
  FROM raw
  WHERE dlc_key_candidate LIKE 'D_%'
)
SELECT * FROM filtered
'''
sup_df = db_api.execute_query(user_id, chat_id, sup_sql)

# Register temps and assemble final
db_api.register_temporary_df(user_id, chat_id, orgs_df, "tmp_orgs")
db_api.register_temporary_df(user_id, chat_id, bldg_df, "tmp_bldg")
db_api.register_temporary_df(user_id, chat_id, name_df, "tmp_name")
db_api.register_temporary_df(user_id, chat_id, sup_df, "tmp_sup")

final_sql = '''
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
WITH base AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(o.dlc_key, b.dlc_key, n.dlc_key, s.dlc_key) AS dlc_key
  FROM tmp_name n
  FULL OUTER JOIN tmp_orgs o ON o.dlc_key = n.dlc_key
  FULL OUTER JOIN tmp_bldg b ON b.dlc_key = COALESCE(o.dlc_key, n.dlc_key)
  FULL OUTER JOIN tmp_sup s ON s.dlc_key = COALESCE(o.dlc_key, b.dlc_key, n.dlc_key)
)
SELECT 
  n.dlc_key,
  n.dlc_name,
  COALESCE(o.total_facility_organizations, 0) AS total_number_of_facility_organizations,
  COALESCE(b.total_number_of_floors, 0) AS total_number_of_floors,
  COALESCE(b.total_square_footage, 0) AS total_square_footage,
  COALESCE(s.total_supervisors, 0) AS total_number_of_supervisors,
  COALESCE(s.total_supervisees, 0) AS total_number_of_supervisees,
  COALESCE(b.total_building_heights, 0) AS total_building_heights
FROM base k
LEFT JOIN tmp_name n ON n.dlc_key = k.dlc_key
LEFT JOIN tmp_orgs o ON o.dlc_key = k.dlc_key
LEFT JOIN tmp_bldg b ON b.dlc_key = k.dlc_key
LEFT JOIN tmp_sup s ON s.dlc_key = k.dlc_key
ORDER BY n.dlc_key
'''

db_api.execute_query(user_id, chat_id, final_sql)
